blurb: Welcome to the Marshfield Saddle Club Home Page. We are glad that you decided to visit us. Our club is made up of friendly folks who enjoy many equine activities. We hold open “Come As You Are” shows and also host a Double-Judged NCWHA sanctioned show. We also hold an End-Of The Year Celebration at which we recognize the placings of our members at our shows.
